title: Normalized derived signed-line reductions and support
statement: Fix ell, E, X, a completed coefficient line L, and ordinary comparison isomorphisms b satisfying PowerFormula [def-pur-integral-line-reduction-data]. There are natural isomorphisms d(m,n): ordinaryTensor(L^[m]) followed by derived reduction_n ≅ derived reduction_n followed by finite ordinary tensor with reduction_n(L)^[m]. They satisfy DerivedFormula: on every good K-flat flat-term representative the chain map is balancing followed by b, agrees with d through the actual reduction counit and specified tensor representative comparisons, and commutes with the strict quotient transitions with TransitionFormula. For every unbounded K, every interval [a,z] containing all cohomological supports of its derived reductions also contains all cohomological supports of the derived reductions of its ordinary twist.

Proof (3), last sentence interpreted in the derived-complete integral coefficient convention; extracted generic reduction/restriction argument

proof.text: Obtain d and its full representative and transition normalization from the normalized derived-comparison theorem. Retain the same d for the support assertion.

Fix m,K,a,z,n and a degree i in the support of the reduced ordinary twist. The component (d m n).app K identifies this object with finiteOrdinary applied to the derived reduction of K. Map that isomorphism through H^i. If the latter cohomology were zero, IsZero.of_iso would make the former zero, contradicting membership in support. Apply finite_ordinary_support_subset and then the given inclusion of the support of the nth reduction of K into Icc a z. The endpoints and all original quantifiers are unchanged.
